book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Mataayo

content: Gano nigo amariina ge ekisyooko kya Yeesu Krisito.
Yeesu Krisito akarweera mukisyooko kyo omutemi Daudi na Aburahamu.

content.text: Yuuda akamwiibhura Pereesi na Zeera ku Tamaari,
Daudi akamwiibhura Soromooni kumukari wuno yaari omukari wa Uria,
na Yosia akamwiibhura Yekonia na bhawamwaabhu,
eriibhaga riyo niryo Abhiiziraeri bhaagegirwe bhabhe abhagya mukyaaro kya Babeeri.
Yaakobo akamwiibhura Yusufu, musubhe wa Mariamu,
na Mariamu akamwiibhura Yeesu wuno akubhirikirwa Masiya.

content: Ambe, okurwa ku Aburahamu okuhikira okwiibhurwa kwo omutemi Daudi zyaari eziinyiibhuro ikumi ni inye. Kweeki, okurwa ku Daudi okuhikira kwiibhaga rino Abhiiziraeri bhaari bhamariri kugegwa kugya Babeeri, zyaari nyiibhuro eziindi ikumi ni inye. Kweeki, okurwa kwiibhaga rino bhaagegirwe bhabhe abhagya, okuhikira okwiibhurwa kwa Masiya, zyaari nyiibhuro eziindi ikumi ni inye.

Engʼana yo okwiibhurwa kwa Yeesu Krisito niyo yino. Mariamu nina waabhu Yeesu, yaari ayuungiibhwe na Yusufu. Nawe yaari akyaari kuhiindira nawe, Mariamu akarorekana ariinda, enda yino yabhweeni kwo obhunagya bhwe Ekoro Muhoreeru.
Yusufu omusubhe waaye, yaari omuutu we eheene embere wa Taatabhugya. Ateendiri amusuukye Mariamu, kweego akaamura kumutiga bhwiibhisi.
Nawe hano Yusufu yaari yamwiiri gayo, kituukiro maraika
wo Omukuru, Taatabhugya akamutuukira mukirooto, akamubhuurira, “Yusufu, omwaana wo omutemi Daudi,
otoobhoha kumukweera Mariamu, kwo okubha enda yiyo ayibhweeni kwo obhunagya bhwe Ekoro Muhoreeru.
Ariibhura omwaana we ekisubhe, no omutoge Yeesu,
kwo okubha wuyo niwe araatuurye abhaatu okurwa mubhibhi bhyaabhu.”
Gayo goosi gaakorirwe ego, okubha rikuunaane eriingʼana rino Omukuru, Taatabhugya yabhugiri kwe enzira yo omurooti waaye kubha,

content.text: “Murore, omukari wuno akyaari kuhiindira no omusubhe aragega enda,

content: Obhugazuro bhwe eriina rino ni kubha, Taatabhugya ari hamwe neetwe.
Hano Yusufu yaabhuukiri, akakora kyeego maraika wo Omukuru, Taatabhugya yamubhuuriiri. Yusufu akamukweera Mariamu,
nawe ataahiindiiri neewe tee hano Mariamu yiibhwiiri omwaana we ekisubhe. Yusufu akamutoga omwaana wuyo, Yeesu.

footnotes.text: Krisito ni ngʼana ye Ekiyunaani, obhugazuro bhwaku ni wuno ahakirwe amaguta. Mu Kieburania bharabhuga Masiya. Rora engʼana yino mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
Omukari wa Uria yaari arabhirikirwa Batisheeba. Rora 2 Samweeri 12:24-25.
Ekoro Muhoreeru. Rora amangʼana gano mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.

Kuriingʼaana ne enyaangi ya Abhayahudi, eraabhe omumura no omuukya bhiiyuungirye, bhahaabhabhara kubha bhiikweeriri. Nawe haari ne eriibhaga ryo omwaaka omugima gwo okwiiganya eriibhaga bhakyaari kukweerana. Eriibhaga ryoosi riyo bhatiikiriibhwe kwiikara hamwe tee hano bhakugya kukweerana. Okumutiga wuno ayuungiibhwe kukatuubhana no okutigana.
a Maraika. Rora engʼana yino mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
b Daudi. Rora engʼana yino mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
Obhugazuro bhwe eriina rya Yeesu ni Mukuru, Taatabhugya aratuurya.
